name: SEOJuice – Automated SEO with Server-Side Rendering
author: seojuice

sections.description:
SEOJuice is a comprehensive SEO automation platform that helps you improve your visibility across traditional search engines and AI platforms. With server-side rendering (SSR) by default, all optimizations are applied before your page loads, making them instantly visible to search engines and improving crawlability.

NEW in Version 2.0: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) mode is now the default for maximum SEO performance. All optimizations are applied server-side before the page reaches the browser.

Core Features

Automated Internal Linking
* AI-powered contextual link suggestions
* Automatically connects relevant pages
* Supports 95+ languages including Asian languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean)
* Custom link classes for styling

Meta Tags & Structured Data
* Automated title tag optimization
* Meta description generation and optimization
* Open Graph tags for social sharing
* JSON-LD structured data (Schema.org)
* Optimized for both search engines and AI platforms

Image Optimization
* AI-generated alt text for all images
* Contextually relevant descriptions
* Accessibility improvements
* Automatic updates based on page content

AI Visibility Tracking
* Monitor your presence in ChatGPT responses
* Track Claude AI citations
* Gemini search visibility
* Perplexity AI appearance tracking
* Real-time prompt analysis

Technical SEO Audits
* Comprehensive site analysis
* Core Web Vitals monitoring
* Page performance benchmarks
* Broken link detection and reporting
* Accessibility issue identification

Competitor Analysis
* Track up to competitors
* Keyword gap analysis
* Content opportunity identification
* Domain rating comparisons
* Backlink analysis

Performance & Analytics
* Google Search Console integration
* Traffic and impression tracking
* Ranking position monitoring
* Real-time performance metrics
* Detailed PDF reports

Agency Features
* Whitelabel support
* Branded reports for clients
* Multi-site management
* Team collaboration tools

How It Works

SEOJuice operates in two modes:

SSR Mode (Recommended – Default)
Server-side rendering applies all optimizations before the page loads. This ensures search engines and AI crawlers see optimized content immediately. Best for SEO performance and crawlability.

Snippet Mode (Optional)
Client-side JavaScript handles optimizations dynamically. Useful for specific theme compatibility or testing scenarios.

Both modes include view tracking for analytics.

Supported Languages

SEOJuice works with 95+ languages including:
* English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese
* Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), Japanese, Korean
* Arabic, Russian, Hindi, and many more
* Automatic language detection and optimization

Compatibility

  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Compatible with page builders (Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, WPBakery)
  • Compatible with caching plugins (WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, SG Optimizer, Hummingbird)
  • Works with SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO)
  • Multisite compatible

External Services

This plugin connects to SEOJuice’s optimization services to provide SEO improvements:

Services Used:
* API: smart.seojuice.io – Fetches SEO optimization data
* CDN: cdn.seojuice.io – Delivers tracking script

Data Processing:
* Page URLs are sent to the API for optimization analysis
* Page content is analyzed via SEOJuice crawlers
* No personal user data is collected
* GDPR compliant

Service Information:
* Terms of Service: https://seojuice.io/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://seojuice.io/privacy-policy/
* Data Processing Agreement: https://seojuice.io/data-processing-agreement/

Technical Details

Server Requirements:
* WordPress 6.9 or higher
* PHP 7.4 or higher
* MySQL 5.6 or higher (for transient caching)

Optional Enhancements:
* Redis or Memcached for Object Cache (recommended for high-traffic sites)
* Cloudflare for additional edge caching

Performance:
* Cached pages: < 50ms overhead
* Cache TTL: 6 hours (configurable via filters)
* API timeout: 5 seconds
* Memory usage: Minimal impact

Hooks & Filters:

Available filters for developers:
* seojuice_cache_ttl – Modify cache expiration time
* seojuice_api_timeout – Change API request timeout
* seojuice_skip_transformation – Skip SSR for specific pages
* seojuice_transformed_html – Modify HTML after transformation

Debug Mode:

Add ?seojuice_refresh=1 to any URL to bypass cache and test fresh API data. Check server response headers for X-SEOJuice-Cache to verify caching status.

Support

Need help? Contact us:
* Email: support@seojuice.io
* Documentation: https://seojuice.io/docs
* Website: https://seojuice.io

About SEOJuice

SEOJuice is built by Vadim Kravcenko to automate tedious SEO tasks and help businesses improve their visibility across traditional search engines and AI platforms. Trusted by thousands of websites worldwide.

Visit https://seojuice.io to learn more and start your free trial.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/seojuice/ or install via WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Sign up for SEOJuice at https://seojuice.io (7-day free trial available)
  4. Add your WordPress site in your SEOJuice dashboard
  5. The plugin will automatically start optimizing your site (SSR mode is enabled by default)

Configuration (Optional)

  1. Go to Settings > SEOJuice in your WordPress admin
  2. Choose between SSR Mode (recommended) or Snippet Mode
  3. Monitor cache status and clear cache if needed
  4. Add ?seojuice_refresh=1 to any URL to bypass cache for testing
sections.faq:
Do I need a SEOJuice account?

Yes, you need an active SEOJuice account. Sign up at https://seojuice.io for a 7-day free trial.

Will this slow down my website?

No. SSR mode processes content server-side with intelligent caching (6-hour TTL). Cached pages have minimal overhead (<50ms). The tracking script loads asynchronously and doesn’t block rendering.

What’s the difference between SSR Mode and Snippet Mode?

SSR Mode (Default): Optimizations are applied server-side before the page loads. Search engines see optimized content immediately. Better for SEO and crawlability.

Snippet Mode: Optimizations are applied client-side via JavaScript. Useful for testing or specific theme compatibility needs.

Both modes include view tracking for analytics.

Is this compatible with caching plugins?

Yes! SEOJuice works seamlessly with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, SG Optimizer, W3 Total Cache, and other popular caching solutions.

Does SEOJuice modify my database?

In SSR mode, optimizations are applied to the HTML output in real-time. Your WordPress database and content remain untouched. This makes it completely safe to deactivate.

What happens if I cancel my subscription?

Your existing optimizations remain active as long as the plugin is installed. You can reactivate anytime. Dashboard analytics and new optimizations will be unavailable during inactive periods.

How do I test if it’s working?

  1. View your page source (right-click > View Page Source)
  2. Look for window.seojuiceSSR = true in the HTML
  3. Check for injected meta tags in the <head> section
  4. Look for the X-SEOJuice-Cache header (HIT or MISS)
  5. Visit your SEOJuice dashboard to see optimization statistics

Does this work with multilingual sites?

Yes! SEOJuice supports 95+ languages and works with multilingual WordPress setups including WPML, Polylang, and TranslatePress.

How often is the cache refreshed?

Cache automatically expires after 6 hours. You can manually clear cache from Settings > SEOJuice or add ?seojuice_refresh=1 to any URL to bypass cache.

Can I use this with Cloudflare?

Yes! SEOJuice works perfectly with Cloudflare. For maximum performance, you can also use our Cloudflare Worker integration for edge-side rendering.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Major Update: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) mode now default
  • Added SSR mode for server-side HTML transformation
  • Added admin settings page for mode switching (SSR/Snippet)
  • Implemented dual caching strategy (Object Cache + Transients)
  • Added cache management with clear cache functionality
  • Meta tags now injected server-side (title, description, OG tags)
  • Structured data (JSON-LD) server-side injection
  • Image alt text transformation server-side
  • Internal link injection with regex matching (Western + Asian languages)
  • Added cache bypass support (?seojuice_refresh=1)
  • Added X-SEOJuice-Cache header for debugging
  • Updated for WordPress 6.9 compatibility
  • Increased PHP requirement to 7.4
  • Improved compatibility with page builders and cache plugins
  • Enhanced performance with intelligent caching

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • JavaScript snippet integration
  • Basic internal linking
  • Cache plugin compatibility filters
